title: Cash deposit machines and deposit discrepancies - explained
content: A cash deposit machine may validate notes and issue a receipt before the credit is fully reflected in the account. Rejected notes and an uncredited accepted deposit are different issues, so retain the receipt and avoid repeated submissions.
